d: Bihar men udyog aur niryat ko barhava dene ki disha men bharat sarkar aur bihar sarkar ke udyog vibhag dvara ek mahatvapurn pahal ki gaee hai. is avsar par bihar ki mantri shreysi sinh ka bayan samne aaya hai, jismen unhonne maujuda udyamiyon, udyog jagat aur niryatkon ke lie aayojit FTA karyashala ke uddeshyon ke bare men jankari sajha ki.
